groups.label: Screens v2 adds
groups.intro: Screens v1 did not have, and five whose shape a 19 November request changed (the Overview, Schedule, My work, Programs and Create program's Systems step). Where a preview's ↗, a link or a button led nowhere in v1, v2 draws the page it names; v1 shows what was there instead.

pairs.v1none: Two gates on Schedule, under Monitor; the CDR due before the PDR; no stages or deliverables

pairs.v1none: Nothing: the fielded increment's milestones, reviews and ATO were not shown
